name: 7-Zip
summary: A free, open-source file archiver for Windows with its own high-compression 7z format and support for many common archive types.

name: AF Media Bar
summary: A taskbar media controller that shows media information, lyrics and playback controls directly on the desktop.

name: BleachBit
summary: BleachBit is a system cleaner that removes unnecessary files to free disk space and protect privacy.

name: electerm
summary: Free and open‑source client for terminal, SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC and Spice connections.

name: FFmpeg GUI Editor Windows
summary: A lightweight portable graphical front‑end for FFmpeg that lets Windows users trim, crop, compress, convert and edit videos without using the command line.

name: Fk Desktop
summary: Fk Desktop is a Pomodoro timer that follows the original technique closely, offering a classic desktop UI, keyboard shortcuts and advanced settings for power users.

name: Headroom Desktop
summary: Headroom Desktop is a tray application that reduces token usage for Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex and similar AI coding tools by about half.

name: InstallerClean
summary: Open source tool to safely clean orphaned Windows Installer files and reclaim disk space.

name: KeePassXC
summary: A free, open-source password manager that keeps your passwords in an encrypted database file you control.

name: LibreGet
summary: LibreGet is a free open‑source download manager and media toolbox for Windows that can download files from courses, YouTube, social sites and many other services, then transcribe, convert and organise the saved content.

name: Moonlight Qt
summary: Moonlight Qt is an open‑source client that lets you stream games and desktop sessions from a PC with NVIDIA GameStream or Sunshine to your Windows computer.

name: MyNotes
summary: A simple notes and reminders application for Windows built with WinUI 3.

name: Notepad++
summary: A free, open-source source code and text editor for Windows with syntax highlighting, tabs, powerful search and plugin support.

name: OBS Studio
summary: Free and open-source software for screen recording and live streaming, built around scenes, sources and an audio mixer.

name: Quiesce
summary: Quiesce safely cleans Windows temporary files, system logs, update caches, and optimizes system memory without heavy installers or background processes.

name: Sakura Editor
summary: A free, open‑source text editor for Windows with support for many file encodings and customizable features.

name: ScreenRecorder
summary: A simple program that records your screen and audio.

name: ShareX
summary: A free, open-source screen capture, screen recording and file-sharing tool for Windows with configurable after-capture workflows.

name: TizuMark
summary: A lightweight Markdown editor for Windows with live preview, outline navigation, KaTeX and Mermaid support.

name: Token Tracker
summary: A local dashboard that tracks token usage and cost for many AI coding tools, with a system‑tray app, desktop pet, widgets and achievement tracking.

name: Traydio
summary: A tiny, simple, elegant internet radio player that lives in the Windows tray.

name: Usque
summary: An unofficial client for Cloudflare WARP services that provides system VPN, SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy with advanced routing, chain proxy, and profile management.

name: Warpinator Windows
summary: An unofficial implementation of Warpinator for Windows.
